h: ADC fires back at APC over deepfake claims and asks for evidence
p: The ADC has rejected allegations by the ruling party that it is behind deepfake content aimed at President Tinubu. The party challenged the APC to publish proof of its claim. The exchange comes on the day Tinubu launches his re-election campaign in Kaduna.
more: The ADC says accusations alone cannot replace evidence.
The row adds to a growing war of words between both campaigns.
